ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central region and 35% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central region bounded by high-intensity distal lobes. Right distal lobe exhibits dense, low-intensity pixel mottling within the high-intensity field. Left distal lobe shows a cleaner transition with sparse mottling near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 18 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels. Distinct peaks are visible along the entire trajectory, with higher density near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the medial trailing edge transitioning to convex at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, circular high-intensity pixels (barnacles) located at the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct high-intensity vertical linear scar is present on the right-central dark field. Faint horizontal and diagonal linear disruptions are visible across the central low-intensity surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity vertical scar on the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and dense black-on-white mottling pattern on the right lobe tip, contrasting with the more uniform white patch on the left lobe tip.
